name: Hauntmare Expo
blurb: A Halloween and horror convention in Fresno, California, with vendors, haunted houses, cosplay and horror-genre celebrity guests.
notes: No 2027 (or later 2026) edition has been announced yet; the homepage still only shows the July 18-19, 2026 dates, which already ended before this window, so editions is empty and that confirmed date is recorded as 'last' instead. The site has a 'Celebrity Guests' grid of about a dozen named horror-convention guests (Audrey Lynn Marie, Eddie Deezen, Eileen Dietz, Kat Cressida, James Pax, Allan Trautman, Brett Wagner and others) plus several ad tiles with only cryptic first-name filenames, but that lineup is for the now-past July 2026 show, not an announced upcoming edition, so it is not recorded here. No ticket link or organizer entity was found on the page.
